verdict.rationale: Credential handling and 2FA login are a fair question for a browser-automation agent framework, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no credential vault, no TOTP/2FA handling, and no mechanism for keeping secrets out of the model's view. Persisted cookies and browser contexts are an adjacent session-reuse feature, not vaulted credential login, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can store credentials in a vault and have the agent complete logins including TOTP/2FA challenges without exposing secrets to the model
